tour6.title: Golden Triangle with Ranthambore
tour6.route: Delhi to Jaipur to Abhaneri to Ranthambore to Fatehpur Sikri to Agra to Delhi

days.desc: You will get a warm welcome by our airport representative / Guide on your arrival at Airport; He will be assisting you for the transfer to the hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Delhi – Jaipur (By Surface – 260kms & 06hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet breakfast at Hotel, Half day City tour of Delhi visiting India Gate, President house, Government building from outside. Also visit to Agrasen ki Baoli-Delhi & move for lunch at local restaurant. Proceed to Jaipur by surface.upon arrival in jaipur check in dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Jaipur City Tour
days.desc: Enjoy morning yoga session at the hotel. Post breakfast proceed for full day city tour visit Amber Fort [Uphill by Elephant/Downhill by Jeep] En-route photo stop at Hawa Mahal. Return back to hotel for lunch, photo stop at Jal Mahal. Post Buffet lunch at hotel, visit City Palace and Birla Temple. Later transfer to Palace Hotel. Diner & Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Jaipur – Ranthambore (By Surface – 260kms & 06hrs)
days.desc: Post breakfast check-out from the hotel and proceed to Ranthambore. Upon arrival Later check – in at Hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Ranthambore
days.desc: Early morning enjoy Game Drive in Ranthambore National Park Shared basis on Open  Canter. Return to Hotel for Buffet breakfast.  Full day at leisure Afternoon Proceed to enjoy another Game Drive in Ranthambore National Park on Shared basis on Open Canter.   Dinner & Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Ranthambore- Abhaneri- Fatehpur Sikri-Agra (By Surface 295 Kms/ 5.5 hrs drive)
days.desc: After buffet breakfast at hotel, checkout from hotel. Start your drive to Agra Enroute visit Abhaneri and visit stepwell and Fatehpur Sikri sightseeing. Lunch in local restaurant in Fatehpur sikri. Continue your drive to Agra.  Upon arrival Later check – in at Hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Agra – Delhi (By Surface – 210kms & 5hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet breakfast at hotel. Start with sightseeing of UNESCO World Heritage Centre -Taj Mahal & Agra Fort. Visiting Taj Mahal “The embodiment of all things pure”, said Rudyard Kipling on Taj Mahal’s beauty and that is no wordplay as the Taj is undoubtedly a pure epitome of beauty. It is an immortal poem in white marble and is the finest expression of love of an emperor for his queen. Located on a bank of River Yamuna, it was built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his beloved wife and Queen Mumtaz Mahal in 1631, who died giving birth to his child and whose last wish to her husband was “to build such a tomb in her memory which the world has never seen before.” It took over 17 years, 22000 workers and 1000 elephants to build the wonderful mausoleum.(Taj Mahal Closed on Friday) Later visit to Agra Red Fort. Agra Fort- A massive red-sandstone fort located on the banks of River Yamuna was built under the commission of Emperor Akbar in 1565 and was further built by his grandson Shah Jahan. The fort, semi-circular on plan, is surrounded by a 21.4 m high fortification wall Post buffet lunch at hotel. Drive to Delhi by surface. Upon arrival, check-in at hotel. Dinner at local restaurant. Overnight at hotel.

Post breakfast check-out from the hotel , Start your sightseeing of Qutub Minar &  Lotus Temple . Lunch at local restaurant.  Afternoon sightseeing of Old Delhi visit to Raj Ghat, Gandhi Smriti, Drive past Jama masjid, Red fort.Evening Dinner at local restaurant, in time transfer to Delhi International airport for your flight to back home. Our representative will assist you at departure.

tour7.title: Honeymoon Trip in Kerala
tour7.route: Cochin to  Munnar – Periyar to  Alleppey  to  Mararikulam  to  Kovalam  to  Trivandrum
tour7.destinations: Cochin,  Munnar – Periyar,  Alleppey ,  Mararikulam ,  Kovalam ,  Trivandrum

days.title: Arrive at Cochin
days.desc: Arrive at Cochin International Airport. Following customs, immigration formalities and baggage collection, our representative will meet you as you exit the arrival terminal building after which you would be transferred to your hotel. Kochi or Cochin is a vibrant city situated on the south-west coast of the Indian peninsula in the breathtakingly scenic and prosperous state of Kerala. Its strategic importance over the centuries is underlined by the sobriquet Queen of the Arabian Sea. It is also referred to as the Gateway to Kerala. Kochi has been luring wanderers and traders for over 600 years and remains a living homage to its varied colonial past: giant fishing nets influenced by Chinese merchants, a 16th-century synagogue, ancient mosques, Portuguese houses and the crumbling residuum of the British Raj. It’s a delightful place to spend some time, soak in the history, and peruse art galleries. Upon arrival at the hotel, check-in at the hotel. In evening, enjoy a tour on waters around the city and get a glimpse of sun setting slowly through sunset cruise in Kochi. This experience gives you a tranquil escape from the bustling metropolitan areas in Cochin. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Cochin
days.desc: Morning enjoy half day sightseeing tour of Cochin. The tour allows you to explore the charming fort Cochin, visit Jewish Synagogue, Dutch Palace, Jew Town, and St Francis church. Fort Kochi is a small village located near the larger city of Kochi. There are picturesque beaches along this part of the coast line. Scattered throughout the beaches are many famous Chinese fishing nets as well as many sailing ships. The effect created by such fishing necessities is quaint and relaxing. This is the only location in the entire world outside of China where such fishing nets can be seen in use. The Dutch Palace is a beautiful palace that was originally built by the Portuguese. It was only during the 17th century that the Dutch took it over, modified it and then presented it to the Raja of Kochi. The main attractions here are the outstanding collection of mural paintings found inside. These murals beautifully depict scenes from the Hindu epics of Mahabharatha and Ramayana. The Jewish synagogue built in Jew Town in 1568 is a beautiful structure. This place of worship attracts numerous visitors every year because of its impressive furnishings. The St. Francis Church is the oldest church in India to have been built by the Europeans. The famous Portuguese trader Vasco da Gama is well known for reaching India from Europe by sea instead of by the usual overland route. The church is famous for being the initial burial place for Vasco Da Gama. In the evening enjoy Kathakali – the traditional dance drama of Kerala it dates from the 17th century and is rooted in Hindu mythology. Kathakali is one of the most complicated, highly stylized Indian art form that is basically a Dance Drama noted for its heavy and attractive larger than life make up, elaborate costumes, detailed body movements, synchronized eye-hands movements and thematic presentation of stories with rhythmic steps.  Kathakali’s popularity traditionally was confined in the Palace Dance Halls, Courtyards of Nair Noble households, Temple festivals etc. till mid of 20th century when Kochi based See India Foundation started India’s first regular professionally run Kathakali theatre in 1964. Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Cochin to Munnar (125 / 04 Hrs )
days.desc: Morning by surface leave for Munnar Munnar is a haven of peace and harmony. This incredibly beautiful hill town is positioned at a height of 6000ft in the Idukki district. Munnar was a significant resort even during the British monarchs in those colonial days. Opulent with unique species of flora and fauna, the place also has an extensive stretch of tea plantations amidst the high mountains and unspoiled valleys, giving a pleasant feeling. The scented cool air is filled with the aroma of spices. Munnar is also paradise for bird watchers as rare species of birds are found in abundance. Rest of the day is at leisure. Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Munnar
days.desc: Morning visit Eravikulam National Park. The park is an ideal place for seeing the biodiversity of high elevation shola-grassland ecosystem. Visitors are taken to Rajamalai in forest department vehicles and given an opportunity to see all this. A sanctuary for the endangered mountain goat of South India, the Nilgiri Tahr (Hemitragus hylocrious), the Eravikulam National Park stands out for the stark beauty of its rolling grasslands and sholas, spread over 97 sq km in the Kannan devan hills. Anamudi, the highest peak (2695 m) south of Himalayas, stands majestically in the core area of the national park. The slopes of the hills abound in many kinds of rare flora which include rare terrestrial and epiphytic orchids, and beautiful wild balsams. Important fauna here are the Nilgiri Tahr, Nilgiri Langur, leopard, tiger, Indian bison, etc. Later visit to the Tea factory. Tea was first brought to Munnar by James Finlay & Sons who formed the Kannan Devan Hill Produce Company which has ultimately become Tata Tea Company. A visit to the tea factory gives one an insight into the fascinating process of tea making. Also visit to Tata Tea Museum located in Nallathanni Estate of Tata Tea. The museum showcases various antiquities and the most famous among them is the burial urn excavated from the vicinity of Periakanal Estate, dating back to 2nd century. Guests can also get a glimpse into the history and culture of the region through a video presentation. Visitors to the museum can satiate their curiosity on various stages of tea processing, and also learn a thing or two about the production of black tea. A demonstration room for tea tasting is another attraction where one would come across different varieties of tea. Evening at leisure Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Munnar to Periyar (100 Kms / 03 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning by surface leave for Periyar , The Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary is situated on the banks of the Periyar Lake - an artificial lake, at Thekkady. Here the high ranges of the Western Ghats are clothed in dense evergreen, moist deciduous forests and savannah grasslands. Periyar is famous for its rich wild life and spice plantation. Evening at Leisure , Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast.

days.title: Periyar
days.desc: Morning visit to Periyar National Park Tourists come to the National Park to view the Indian elephants in the act of ablution and playfulness by the Periyar lake. Apart from Elephants, the other animals to be seen in the Periyar sanctuary are Gaur, Wild Pigs, Sambhar, Barking Deer, Mouse Deer, Dole or Indian Wild Dog and very rarely, a Tiger. More than 200 species of birds have been spotted in the forests of this protected area. With the Periyar Lake in the middle, this sanctuary is a huge attraction for water birds and birds that prey on fish. The bird life here includes cormorants, kingfishers, darters, the Racket-Tailed Drongo and the Malabar hornbill. Boat cruises make the best option to check out the wilds of Periyar Sanctuary. Although it is unusual to see many animals from the boats, still you spot a family of Elephants, Wild Boar, and Sambar Deer by the water's edge. Later visit to Spice Plantation. Gift wrapped in lush green spice plantations, Periyar is the heartland of spices. The trip covers spice plantations such as cardamom, pepper, vanilla, clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, ayurvedic herbs etc. Over twelve varieties of spices including ginger, garlic, cardamom, vanilla, pepper, cinnamon, coffee, tea, clove and nutmeg are cultivated in Thekkady and its neighboring villages. Evening at leisure , Stay overnight at Hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Periyar to Alleppey (127 Kms / 05 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning by surface leave for Alleppey Later embark houseboat followed by lunch at house boat. These houseboats or Kettuvallams as they are traditionally called were at one time the mode of transportation for man and goods. Today, these are made to cater to the discerning guests who can lay back and enjoy the gentle cruise. Cruise the backwaters from the main Vembanad Lake through the small estuaries that link small villages to the mainland. Today, these are refurbished and all modern conveniences have been added for tourists who visit this beautiful water locked region of the country.  Evening is at leisure. Stay overnight at Houseboat. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.title: Alleppey – Mararikulam (20 Kms /45 Min)
days.desc: Morning disembark houseboat and enjoy a walk around the village - “Alleppey on Foot”. The program starts with a slide show on the past and Present of Alleppey conducted at their interpretation centre, followed by walk through the streets of Alleppey in which the guide (volunteer) will explain about the architecture of the buildings on both sides of the streets. It’s not a fully walking tour, in between car drives are taken as the streets are little far off. The tour ends with a walk through Mullackel street with light snacks and tea. After the walking tour leave for Mararikulam Mararikulam is a peaceful place to relax and unwind. Those who visit Marari look forward to the slow pace of life, and soaking up the serenity and tranquility on the deserted sandy beaches. This beach is quiet and undeveloped. The name Marari is shortened from from Mararikulam, a small and sleepy fisherman's village. It is situated between the port city of Cochin and Alleppey. Here the life still goes on much as it did a hundred years ago, with the men going out to sea each day to earn a living bringing in the daily catch. Day at leisure , Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Mararikulam
days.desc: Learn from our master Yoga teacher giving you expert guidance, this ancient science of wellness acquires a new dimension. One of the best things about yoga is that almost anyone can do it regardless of age. The Ayurvedic centre has qualified doctors, you can consult, and they will be happy to introduce you to this ancient form of no-side-effects medicine. It’s a great way to start your day at Marari. Later, you may stroll or a bicycle ride through the village around the Marari. Meandering sleepy lanes are dotted with little groceries, patchworks of political posters, perma-smiling school kids, and the colours unroll. Day at leisure on the beach Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfas

days.title: Mararikulam to Kovalam (178 Km/04 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning by surface drive to Kovalam , Arrive at Kovalam and transfer to the hotel. Kovalam is an internationally renowned beach with three adjacent crescent beaches. It has been a favourite haunt of tourists, especially Europeans, since the 1930s. A massive rocky promontory on the beach has created a beautiful bay of calm waters ideal for sea bathing. The leisure options at this beach are plenty and diverse. Sunbathing, swimming, herbal body toning massages, special cultural programs and catamaran cruising are some of them. The tropical sun acts so fast that one can see the faint blush of coppery tan on the skin in a matter of minutes. Evening at leisure on the beach, Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Kovalam
days.desc: Early morning you may experience yoga session on the beach. Kovalam is also a getaway destination for those in search of an Ayurvedic haven away from the cacophony of city life. The experience is personal and unique. Medicinal plants that come fresh from the spa greenhouse are used in the treatment. Day to rejuvenate your mind, body and soul at the resort , Evening at leisure on the beach, Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Kovalam – Day excursion of Padmanabhapuram Palace and Kanyakumari
days.desc: In the morning proceed for the day excursion to Padmanabhapuram Palace and Kanyakumari (184 Km both ways). Padmanabhapuram Palace, regarded as Asia's largest wooden palace located at Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala. Palace lies at the land's end of mainland India - Kanyakumari. An enticing ediffice to any lover of art and architecture this old palace of the Rajas of the erstwhile Travancore (1550 to 1750 AD) is a fine specimen of Kerala's indigenous style of architecture. The antique interiors are replete with intricate rosewood carvings and sculptured decor. One of the most exotic places to go in India is the city of Kanyakumari, also known as Cape Comorin, which is filled with many and interesting tourist attractions. Perhaps what makes it so interesting is the fact that it is located at the southernmost part of India, hence it is somewhat of a well of culture ready to be explored by tourists. In Kanyakumari, you can find instances of many religions like Islam, Christianity, or Hinduism easily. Its mixed heritage of the city has called out for many people for pilgrimage that has been going on for centuries. The city of Kanyakumari with its southern coast to the vast and the powerful Indian Ocean impressed the British so much, that they decided to rename it to Cape Comorin to accentuate its beauty. Stay overnight at hotel. Meal Plan – Buffet Breakfast

days.title: Kovalam to Trivandrum and Departure
days.desc: Morning after breakfast, transfer to Trivandrum Airport and connect to onward flight journey.

tour8.title: Kashmir with Golden Triangle Tour
tour8.route: Delhi to Srinagar to Pahalgam to Gulmarg to Agra to Jaipur to Delhi
tour8.destinations: Delhi, Srinagar, Pahalgam, Gulmarg, Agra, Jaipur, Delhi

days.title: Arrive Delhi (By Flight)
days.desc: Upon arrival at Delhi airport, meet assist and transfer to hotel India’s capital and a major gateway to the country, contemporary Delhi is a bustling metropolis, which successfully combines in its folds - the ancient with the modern. Amidst the fast spiraling skyscrapers the remnants of a bygone time in the form of its many monuments stand as silent reminders to the region’s ancient legacy. The first impressions for any visitor traveling in from the airport are of a specious, garden city, tree-lined with a number of beautiful parks. Overnight at hotel.

days.title: Delhi / Srinagar (By Flight)
days.desc: Early breakfast at hotel Have breakfast at the hotel and depart for the airport, take a flight to Srinagar (flying about 1 hr 30 minutes) On arrival in Srinagar, You will be greeted & start drive to Srinagar for 35 minutes. Srinagar is the largest city and the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It lies in the Kashmir Valley on the banks of the Jhelum River, a tributary of the Indus, and Dal and Anchar lakes. The city is known for its natural environment, gardens, waterfronts and houseboats. The drive takes you past the Abdullah bridge which connects the banks of the Jhelum river, snaking its way towards the North-Western frontier of Kashmir. Arrive and check in at Deluxe Houseboat. Early Lunch at Deluxe Houseboat. Proceed for sightseeing for Shalimar Garden, Chashmashahi & Nishat Garden. Shalimar Garden: (Shalimar Bagh - Garden of Love)  is the famous royal garden of Kashmir. The name Shalimar "abode of love" may be derived from the name of the structure built by Pravarsena II in the 6th century AD, when the garden was a sacred Hindu site. Emperor Jahangir was so enamored with the garden that he called it "one of the sights of Kashmir". Nishat Garden (Nishat Bagh - Garden of Happiness) , the second largest garden in Kashmir Valley, after Shalimar Bagh and one of the most tourist attractions in Srinagar (Spring from mid-March to mid-May will have Tulip Festival). Guests enjoy a garden with a seasonally changing landscape  "yellow maple leaves in autumn"  or  "white snow cover the garden in winter". These gardens were Mughal Emperors concept of Paradise and today these are popular picnic spots. Also visit a handicraft shop where you can purchase local Hand Crafted items-Shawls, Jackets, Bed Covers, Paper Mache, Carpets & much more, In the evening leisurely stroll alongside the Dal Lake exploring the local markets. In the Evening visit Shankaracharya temple, Hazratbal Shrine. Dinner & Overnight stay at Deluxe Houseboat.

days.title: Srinagar – Pahalgam - Srinagar
days.desc: After breakfast, Checkout from Houseboat. Drive to Pahalgam for Same day excursion. Pahalgam is a hill station in the north Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir. Mountain trails run northeast to Amarnath Cave Temple, a Hindu shrine and site of the annual Amarnath Yatra pilgrimage. Overa Aru Wildlife Sanctuary is home to animals including brown bears and musk deer. Northeast, the Lidder River runs through scenic Betaab Valley. Southeast, Tulian Lake is flanked by mountain peaks and often frozen. Afternoon, after sightseeing of Pahalgam. Return to Srinagar. Checkin at Hotel. Overnight at Hotel

days.title: Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar
days.desc: After breakfast full day excursion of Gulmarg - the most beautiful summer resort in the valley. Gulmarg is the crowning glory of Jammu & Kashmir and is located 2,650 meters above sea level. Known as the “Meadow of Flowers”, it boasts of the worlds. One of the main attractions in Gulmarg is the Gulmarg Gondola, the Highest Cable Car in the world. It is popular for its highest golf course and skiing in winter & world’s highest Cable car gondola, you can Enjoy a pony ride (at your own cost) and also enjoy a Gondola ride (cable car – 1st Phase) to Khilanmarg & Aparwath. Return to Srinagar in evening for overnight stay at Hotel, Overnight stay at Hotel

days.title: Srinagar – Delhi(Flight)  - Agra ( Surface 200 kms/ 4 hrs approx..)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel. Early in the morning enjoy the beauty of Dal Lake that God has graced this city with which is often compared to Venice. You will get a view of some very interesting places around the Lake through Shikara such as "floating market on Dal Lake". After having an early lunch, your vehicle will take you to the airport for a domestic flight back to Delhi. On arrival at Delhi airport, straight drive to Agra (210 km/ 3.5 hrs drive). On arrival in Agra, Checkin at Hotel. Agra is a city offering a discovery of the beautiful era. Agra has a rich history, reflected in its numerous monuments dotted in and around the city. The earliest citation for Agra comes from the mythological era, where the epic Mahabharata refer Agra as ‘Agravana’ meaning paradise in Sanskrit. ‘Ptolemy’, the famous second century A.D. geographer, was the first person who referred Agra with its modern name. The Modern Agra was founded by Sikandar Lodi, ruler of Lodi dynasty in 16th century. It was when Shah Jahan descended the Mughal throne that Agra reached the zenith of architectural beauty. Overnight at Hotel.

days.title: Agra/Jaipur by Surface (Approx 255 Kms / 4.5 Hrs)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel. Morning Half day sightseeing of Taj Mahal & Agra Fort. Visiting Taj Mahal“The embodiment of all things pure”, said Rudyard Kipling on Taj Mahal’s beauty and that is no wordplay as the Taj is undoubtedly a pure epitome of beauty. It is an immortal poem in white marble and is the finest expression of love of an emperor for his queen. Located on a bank of River Yamuna, it was built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his beloved wife and Queen Mumtaz Mahal in 1631, who died giving birth to his child and whose last wish to her husband was “to build such a tomb in her memory which the world has never seen before.” It took over 17 years, 22000 workers and 1000 elephants to build the wonderful mausoleum (Taj Mahal Closed on Friday) Agra Fort A massive red-sandstone fort located on the banks of River Yamuna was built under the commission of Emperor Akbar in 1565 and was further built by his grandson Shah Jahan. The fort, semi-circular on plan, is surrounded by a 21.4 m high fortification wall. Drive to Jaipur. Jaipur founded in AD 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan is popularly known as the Pink City. With broad avenues and spacious gardens, the city is steeped in history and culture. Here the past comes alive in magnificent forts and palaces, blushed pink, where once lived the maharajas. The bustling bazaars of Jaipur, famous for Rajasthan jewelry, fabric and shoes, possess a timeless quality and are a treasure-trove for the shoppers. On arrival, check-in at Hotel.

days.title: Jaipur/Delhi by Surface (Approx 260 Kms / 5 Hrs)
days.desc: After early Breakfast. Proceed for sightseeing tour of City Palace & Amer fort – (Jeep ride) City Palace complex was conceived and built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, the founder of Jaipur. A beautiful fusion of Mughal and Rajput architecture, the palace is still home to the last ruling royal family which lives in a private section of the palace. Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II is credited with building most of the structures, but it was expanded upon by later rulers as well. The City Palace Complex includes the Diwan-E-Am (Hall of public audience), Diwan-E-Khas (Hall of private audience), Mubarak Mahal (the palace of reception) and the Maharani’s Palace (the palace of the queen). Mubarak Mahal now houses the Maharaja Sawai Man Singh II Museum and displays a vast and unique collection of royal costumes. Amber Fort, (pronounced Amer) is at a distance of about 11 kilometres from Jaipur. A UNESCO World Heritage Site, it was the bastion of the Kachwahas of Amber, until the capital was moved to the plains, to what is today Jaipur. The palace, located in craggy hills, is a beautiful melange of Hindu and Mughal styles. Raja Man Singh I began construction in 1592 and the palace, which was built as a strong, safe haven against attacking enemies, was completed by Mirja Raja Jai Singh Make you Jaipur holidays a special one with this Jeep ride (4 x 4) while going to Amer Fort, Jaipur. Explore the magnificent places near Amer Fort and it's surroundings. Continue your drive through the scenic beauty of the region and take some memorable pictures. Proceed for drive to Delhi. On arrival in Delhi, proceed for short tour by Drive past India Gate (War Memorial Arch), President's House, and Parliament House & Government Secretariat Buildings Later proceed for airport to board fight to your home & taking back memories.

tour9.title: Rajasthan Forts and Palaces Tour
tour9.route: Delhi  to  Mandawa  to  Bikaner  to  Jaisalmer  to  Jodhpur – Ranakpur  to  Udaipur  to  Pushkar  to  Jaipur – Fatehpur Sikri  to  Agra – Delhi
tour9.destinations: Delhi ,  Mandawa ,  Bikaner ,  Jaisalmer ,  Jodhpur – Ranakpur ,  Udaipur ,  Pushkar ,  Jaipur – Fatehpur Sikri ,  Agra – Delhi

days.title: Arrive Delhi by Flight
days.desc: Arrive at Delhi’s Airport. Welcome to India! and transferred to hotel for check in. Delhi, India’s capital territory, is a massive metropolitan area in the country’s north. In Old Delhi, a neighborhood dating to the 1600s, stands the imposing Mughal-era Red Fort, a symbol of India, and the sprawling Jama Masjid mosque, whose courtyard accommodates 25,000 people. Nearby is Chandni Chowk, a vibrant bazaar filled with food carts, sweets shops and spice stalls. Dinner and Overnight at the hotel.

days.title: Delhi- Mandawa (257 Kms. /06 Hrs. drive)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Drive to Mandawa, on arrival at Mandawa, Check in to Hotel. Visit the Mandawa Fort - Mandawa Fort is an important heritage site of Shekhawati. It was built by the then Thakur Nawal Singh Bahadur, descendant of the Shekhawati rulers at Mandawa town and enjoy the majestic interiors of this architecture. You can also visit Hanuman Prasad Goenka Haveli, Murmuria Haveli, Mohan Lal Saraf Haveli, and Gulab Rai Ladia Haveli.  Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Mandawa-Bikaner (190 Kms. /04 Hrs. drive)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Drive to Bikaner, Visit the Junagarh Fort (1571-1611 AD) constructed of red sandstone and marble with kiosks and balconies embellishing the structure at intervals. On arrival at Bikaner, Check in to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bikaner - Jaisalmer (Approx. 330 Kms / 06 Hrs.)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, drive through the desert and proceed for Jaisalmer. Very often one can see along the road to Jaisalmer some of the antelopes of this region. Blackbuck and fast running Chinkara are the most common among them. Arrive in Jaisalmer in the late evening. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Jaisalmer
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Sightseeing in Jaisalmer. There will have a walk through the old city and visit the carved havellis, fort, Jain temple and Gadisar Lake. In the afternoon will drive around 40 km. away from Jaisalmer to Sam dunes where enjoy the sunset, The most popular excursion to see the total sandy bush less desert. It has a truly glorious stretch of sweeping sand dunes. It is best to be here at sunrise or sunset, drive back to Jaisalmer. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Jaisalmer- Osian- Jodhpur (Approx. 280 Kms / 05 Hrs.)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, drive to Jodhpur via Osian. Osian is a great center of Hindu and Jain religions. The oldest Temple here was constructed in 1178 AD. In Jodhpur you will visit the Mehrangarh Fort (majestic fort). Mehrangarh Fort was built on a steep hill and is among the best in India with exquisitely latticed windows in residential apartments within. You will also visit the Jaswant Thada, a royal cenotaph built in white marble. After the sightseeing you will have a walk through the Bazaars of Jodhpur. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Jodhpur- Ranakpur- Udaipur (250 Kms. /5 ½ Hrs.)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Drive to Udaipur, en-route visit Ranakpur Jain Temple, This 15th-century temple, dedicated to Lord Rishabdeva, is renowned for its intricate marble carvings and stunning architecture. The temple complex includes 29 halls, each adorned with thousands of or-nate pillars. Continue drive to Udaipur, known as the "City of Lakes" for its beautiful water bodies and romantic ambiance. Upon arrival, check in to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Udaipur
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Sightseeing of Udaipur, Visit the City Palace, a sprawling complex of palaces built over 400 years. Explore the palace’s various courtyards, rooms, and museums, including the Crystal Gallery and the Peacock Courtyard. The palace offers stunning views of Lake Pichola and the city. Then visit the Jagdish Temple, a 17th-century shrine dedicated to Lord Vishnu. Admire its intricate carvings and tranquil surroundings. In the afternoon, enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola, taking in the serene waters and picturesque views of the City Palace, Lake Palace, and Jag Mandir. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Udaipur-Pushkar (Approx. 280 Kms / 06 Hrs.)
days.desc: This morning, have breakfast and then leave for Pushkar to enjoy the last set of attractions during your tour of Rajasthan. On reaching Pushkar, check in at the hotel and freshen up. After that, your guide will take you sightseeing around the place. First, visit famous attractions, including Pushkar Lake, Brahma Temple, and Old RangJi Temple. After visiting the temples, head to Pushkar Lake, one of the holiest places in this city. Later, return to the hotel for dinner and have a comfortable night’s stay.Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Pushkar-Jaipur (Approx. 141 Kms / 02 Hrs. 30 Min)
days.desc: Leave for Jaipur in the morning, after breakfast. You then check in to your hotel room and spend the rest of the day at your own leisure. Later, in the evening/night, you come back to the room and stay overnight.

days.title: Jaipur
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, then proceed for sightseeing visiting Amer Fort - 11 Kms from Jaipur is Amber, the ancient capital of Jaipur state construction of the Fort Palace was constructed in 1652 by Raja Mansingh and it was later extended & completed by the Jai Singh before the move to Jaipur. Enjoy elephant ride (Optional) while climbing up to the Amer Fort. Then visit City Palace- was the principle residence of the former ruling family and is known for its stunning architecture. It also includes museum, courtyards, and gardens. Then proceed to visit Jantar Mantar. Then you will free time for shopping. Jaipur is a city of vibrant colors and markets (bazaars) of Jaipur verify this fact. Jaipur's colorful markets offer a great break to stop and shop on you tour. Usually tourists include shopping and visiting the lively markets of Jaipur in their itinerary. While moving through the markets, you will come across the vivacious culture of this region. Jaipur is the perfect place to shop for Handicrafts, antiques, jewelry, gems, pottery, carpets, textiles, metal work and leather ware. After visit transfer to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Jaipur-Abhneri-Fatehpursikri-Agra (Approx. 240 Kms / 5 Hrs)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, then drive to Agra, En-route visit Abhaneri and Fatehpur Sikri- 37 Km, The deserted city of sandstone built by the Emperor. The city is rectangular in shape with nine huge gates & inside there are palaces, meeting halls (public/ private audiences), huge courtyards. After sightseeing drive to Agra. On arrival, check-in at hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Agra-Delhi(Approx. 240 Kms / 4 Hrs)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, then drive to Delhi. After check out from hotel Proceed for the sightseeing of Agra city first visiting one of the world’s most popular monument – Taj Mahal  (it is closed on every Friday) built by Mughal Emperor Shah- Jehan for his Empress Mumtaj Mahal. The construction believed to have taken 22 years to complete with over 20,000 craftsmen working round the clock, Now proceed for sightseeing tour of magnificent Agra Fort- built at the bank of Yamuna river, is situated in the center of the town. Various styles of the architecture are evident within the fort & demonstrate the love of Mughal Emperors towards building beautiful monuments. Rest of the time free for shopping. Agra is known for its fabulous marble-made handicrafts and soft stone inlay work. The Mughal were great patrons of arts and crafts. After sightseeing transfer to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Delhi
days.desc: After breakfast and energize yourself for a day full of excitement and fun. Then, enjoy your day with a sightseeing tour around this beautiful city. Start your tour with a visit to Laxmi Narayan Temple, which is well-known as the Birla Mandir. Later, you can visit attractions like Parliament House, India gate, Lotus Temple, and Qutub Minar. Post sightseeing, return to the hotel for dinner and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Leave Delhi
days.desc: After breakfast proceed to Delhi airport to board flight for onward destination. *****Tour Ends******

tour10.title: South India Vacation Tour
tour10.route: Chennai to Pondicherry to Tanjore to Trichy to Madurai to Periyar to Cochin to Allepy to Kovalam to Trivendrum
tour10.destinations: Chennai, Pondicherry, Tanjore, Trichy, Madurai, Periyar, Cochin, Allepy, Kovalam, Trivendrum

days.title: Arrival in Chennai
days.desc: You will get a warm welcome by our airport representative / Guide on your arrival at Airport; He will be assisting you for the transfer to the hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Chennai
days.desc: Chennai, the capital city, popularly regarded as the ‘Gateway to the South represents a culture that is distinctly different from that of northern India. After breakfast visit, Fort St. George built in 1653 during British reign in India, - now houses the Secretariat and Legislative Assembly of Tamil Nadu; St. Mary’s Church, the oldest Anglican Church in India with its premises; Sri Parthasarathy Temple built by Pallavas in the 8th century AD; Kapaliswara Temple, Mylapore also an eighth century Pallava Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva; San Thomas Cathedral Basilica rebuilt in 1606 as a cathedral and in 1896 it was made a basilica. Overnight stay in the hotel.

days.title: Chennai-Pondicherry(approx 161 kms / 03 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning drive to Pondicherry enroute visiting The  city  of  Mahabalipuram, famous for the seven pagodas. Here  on the  seashore  is an interesting group of ancient rock temples which  are the  examples of  Dravidian style of Architecture. Later drive to Pondicherry.  On arrival check in the hotel for overnight stay.

days.title: Pondicherry-Thanjore (approx 200 kms / 04 hrs)
days.desc: Morning after breakfast visit Pondicherry city, the capital of French India before independence,  Pondicherry  traces its  origin  to  Saint  Agasthya, the revered sage of the south and excavations near-by reveal that a Roman settlement existed here  2000 years ago. It was the theatre of many a battle between then drive to Thanjore. On arrival check in the hotel. Later visit the temple in Thanjore Overnight stay in the hotel.

days.title: Thanjore-Trichy
days.desc: After breakfast half day visit to Trichy (approx 50 kms / 30 minutes one way). The  Rock-Fort  is   the landmark of Trichy. A climb of 434 steps leads to the ancient   temple of Ganapati on top and a further climb to a Shiva temple.  Afternoon sightseeing of Trichy. overnight stay at Hotel

days.title: Trichy-Madurai (approx 182 kms / 05 hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast at the hotel drive to Madurai, on arrival check in the hotel. Afternoon visit the famous Meenakshi Temple dedicated to the  consort of   Lord Shiva  with  its towering gopurams (rising high above the  surrounding country  side). Later, visit the  Tirumala Nayak Palace – A   gracious building  in the Indo saracenic style, famous for the Stucco  work  on its  domes , Overnight stay in the hotel.

days.title: Madurai-Periyar (approx 170 kms / 04 hrs)
days.desc: Morning drive to Periyar. The earliest sanctuary to be set up in 1934, it extends to 777  square kms & forms part of the high mountain ranges, the Western Ghats.  Wild life  can  be  seen while cruising on Periyar Lake in  a  motor  boat. Amongst the animals which can be seen are elephants, wild boar, sambar, tiger, leopard, wild dog, langur monkeys, etc Overnight in the hotel

days.title: Periyar-Cochin (approx 160 kms / 04 Hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast drive to Cochin, on arrival check in the hotel, Overnight in the hotel

days.title: Cochin
days.desc: Morning after breakfast city tour of the Cochin ity. Cochin is the natural harbour created by the famed underwater Malabar mud-banks whose quality ensures that the rougher the seas are outside the calmer the waters are within the Harbour. Vasco-de-Gama placed it on the world  map. It has a Jewish synagogue, Portuguese churches, mosques and Hindu temples. Watch the Chinese Fishing Nets. In the evening enjoy the Kathakali Dance show, Overnight stay in the hotel

days.title: Cochin-Alleppey (approx 60 kms / 01 Hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast drive to Alleppey and board the houseboatd. The coastal town of Alleppey on the Arabian Sea is the Venice of the East, for the numerous canals that meander through the town Overnight stay in the hotel

days.title: Alleppey-Kovalam(approx 160 kms / 3.5 Hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast de-board the houseboat at Thottapally and drive to Kovalam, on arrival check in the hotel, rest of the day is free Overnight stay in the hotel.

days.title: Kovalam
days.desc: After breakfast full day excursion to Kanya kumari enroute visiting Padmanabhapuram Palace, on arrival at Kanyakumari visit the Vivekananda Rock, the national monument dedicated to Swami Vivekananda. The memorial is built at the convergence of the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and India Ocean. In the evening enjoy the lovely sunset view and return on time to the hotel for overnight stay.

days.d: Day at leisure. Overnight stay in the hotel

days.title: Kovalam-Trivandrum airport Drop.
days.desc: After breakfast transfer to Trivandrum Airport to board the flight for onward destination

tour11.title: Kerala Spice Tour
tour11.route: Cochin  to  Munnar  to  Periyar  to  Alleppey  to  Kovalam to  Trivendrum
tour11.destinations: Cochin ,  Munnar ,  Periyar ,  Alleppey ,  Kovalam,  Trivendrum

days.title: Arrive at Cochin Airport
days.desc: Arrive at Cochin International Airport. Following customs, immigration formalities and baggage collection, our representative will meet you as you exit the arrival terminal building after which you would be transferred to your hotel. Kochi or Cochin is a vibrant city situated on the south-west coast of the Indian peninsula in the breathtakingly scenic and prosperous state of Kerala. Its strategic importance over the centuries is underlined by the sobriquet Queen of the Arabian Sea. It is also referred to as the Gateway to Kerala. Kochi has been luring wanderers and traders for over 600 years and remains a living homage to its varied colonial past: giant fishing nets influenced by Chinese merchants, a 16th-century synagogue, ancient mosques, Portuguese houses and the crumbling residuum of the British Raj. It’s a delightful place to spend some time, soak in the history, and peruse art galleries. Upon arrival at the hotel, check-in at the hotel. In evening, enjoy a tour on waters around the city and get a glimpse of sun setting slowly through sunset cruise in Kochi. This experience gives you a tranquil escape from the bustling metropolitan areas in Cochin. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Cochin
days.desc: After Buffet Breakfast at hotel. Morning enjoy half day sightseeing tour of Cochin. The tour allows you to explore the charming fort Cochin, visit Jewish Synagogue, Dutch Palace, Jew Town, and St Francis church. Fort Kochi is a small village located near the larger city of Kochi. There are picturesque beaches along this part of the coast line. Scattered throughout the beaches are many famous Chinese fishing nets as well as many sailing ships. The effect created by such fishing necessities is quaint and relaxing. This is the only location in the entire world outside of China where such fishing nets can be seen in use. The Dutch Palace is a beautiful palace that was originally built by the Portuguese. It was only during the 17th century that the Dutch took it over, modified it and then presented it to the Raja of Kochi. The main attractions here are the outstanding collection of mural paintings found inside. These murals beautifully depict scenes from the Hindu epics of Mahabharatha and Ramayana. The Jewish synagogue built in Jew Town in 1568 is a beautiful structure. This place of worship attracts numerous visitors every year because of its impressive furnishings. The St. Francis Church is the oldest church in India to have been built by the Europeans. The famous Portuguese trader Vasco da Gama is well known for reaching India from Europe by sea instead of by the usual overland route. The church is famous for being the initial burial place for Vasco Da Gama. In the evening enjoy Kathakali – the traditional dance drama of Kerala it dates from the 17th century and is rooted in Hindu mythology. Kathakali is one of the most complicated, highly stylized Indian art form that is basically a Dance Drama noted for its heavy and attractive larger than life make up, elaborate costumes, detailed body movements, synchronized eye-hands movements and thematic presentation of stories with rhythmic steps. Kathakali’s popularity traditionally was confined in the Palace Dance Halls, Courtyards of Nair Noble households, Temple festivals etc. till mid of 20th century when Kochi based See India Foundation started India’s first regular professionally run Kathakali theatre in 1964. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Cochin- Munnar (125 kms / 04 Hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet Breakfast at hotel. Morning by surface leave for Munnar. Munnar is a haven of peace and harmony. This incredibly beautiful hill town is positioned at a height of 6000ft in the Idukki district. Munnar was a significant resort even during the British monarchs in those colonial days. Opulent with unique species of flora and fauna, the place also has an extensive stretch of tea plantations amidst the high mountains and unspoiled valleys, giving a pleasant feeling. The scented cool air is filled with the aroma of spices. Munnar is also paradise for bird watchers as rare species of birds are found in abundance. Rest of the day is at leisure. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Munnar-Periyar (100 Kms / 03 Hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet Breakfast at hotel.  Morning visit Eravikulam National Park. The park is an ideal place for seeing the biodiversity of high elevation shola-grassland ecosystem. Visitors are taken to Rajamalai in forest department vehicles and given an opportunity to see all this. A sanctuary for the endangered mountain goat of South India, the Nilgiri Tahr (Hemitragus hylocrious), the Eravikulam National Park stands out for the stark beauty of its rolling grasslands and sholas, spread over 97 sq km in the Kannan devan hills. Anamudi, the highest peak (2695 m) south of Himalayas, stands majestically in the core area of the national park. The slopes of the hills abound in many kinds of rare flora which include rare terrestrial and epiphytic orchids, and beautiful wild balsams. Important fauna here are the Nilgiri Tahr, Nilgiri Langur, leopard, tiger, Indian bison, etc. After sightseeing drive to Periyar. The Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary is situated on the banks of the Periyar Lake - an artificial lake, at Thekkady. Here the high ranges of the Western Ghats are clothed in dense evergreen, moist deciduous forests and savannah grasslands. Periyar is famous for its rich wild life and spice plantation. Evening Later visit to Spice Plantation. Gift wrapped in lush green spice plantations, Periyar is the heartland of spices.  The trip covers spice plantations such as cardamom, pepper, vanilla, clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, ayurvedic herbs etc. Over twelve varieties of spices including ginger, garlic, cardamom, vanilla, pepper, cinnamon, coffee, tea, clove and nutmeg are cultivated in Thekkady and its neighboring villages. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Periyar - Alleppey (127 Kms / 04 Hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet Breakfast at hotel. Morning visit to Periyar National Park Tourists come to the National Park to view the Indian elephants in the act of ablution and playfulness by the Periyar lake. Apart from Elephants, the other animals to be seen in the Periyar sanctuary are Gaur, Wild Pigs, Sambhar, Barking Deer, Mouse Deer, Dole or Indian Wild Dog and very rarely, a Tiger. More than 200 species of birds have been spotted in the forests of this protected area. With the Periyar Lake in the middle, this sanctuary is a huge attraction for water birds and birds that prey on fish. The bird life here includes cormorants, kingfishers, darters, the Racket-Tailed Drongo and the Malabar hornbill.  Boat cruises make the best option to check out the wilds of Periyar Sanctuary. Although it is unusual to see many animals from the boats, still you spot a family of Elephants, Wild Boar, and Sambar Deer by the water's edge. Later drive to Alleppey. On arrival, checkin Deluxe Houseboat. Later embark houseboat followed by lunch at house boat. These houseboats or Kettuvallams as they are traditionally called were at one time the mode of transportation for man and goods. Today, these are made to cater to the discerning guests who can lay back and enjoy the gentle cruise. Cruise the backwaters from the main Vembanad Lake through the small estuaries that link small villages to the mainland. Today, these are refurbished and all modern conveniences have been added for tourists who visit this beautiful water locked region of the country.  Evening is at leisure. Stay overnight at Houseboat. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Alleppey – Kovalam (158 Kms / 05 Hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet Breakfast at houseboat , Disembark from houseboat and by surface drive to Kovalam. Arrive at Kovalam and transfer to the hotel. Kovalam is an internationally renowned beach with three adjacent crescent beaches. It has been a favourite haunt of tourists, especially Europeans, since the 1930s. A massive rocky promontory on the beach has created a beautiful bay of calm waters ideal for sea bathing. The leisure options at this beach are plenty and diverse. Sunbathing, swimming, herbal body toning massages, special cultural programs and catamaran cruising are some of them. The tropical sun acts so fast that one can see the faint blush of coppery tan on the skin in a matter of minutes. Evening at leisure on the Samudra Light house beach Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Kovalam
days.desc: After Buffet Breakfast at hotel. Early morning you may experience yoga session on the beach. Kovalam is also a getaway destination for those in search of an Ayurvedic haven away from the cacophony of city life. The experience is personal and unique. Medicinal plants that come fresh from the spa greenhouse are used in the treatment. Day to rejuvenate your mind, body and soul at the resort. Evening at leisure on the beach. Stay overnight at hotel.

days.title: Kovalam – Trivandrum Airport Drop
days.desc: Morning after breakfast, drive to Trivandrum. Afternoon visit for local shopping tour & later transfer to Trivandrum Airport and connect to onward flight journey.

tour12.title: Srinagar with Leh Ladakh Tour
tour12.route: Delhi – Srinagar – Pahalgam – Kargil – Leh –– Nubra – Nubra Valley to  Pangong Lake – Leh  to  Delhi
tour12.destinations: Delhi – Srinagar – Pahalgam – Kargil – Leh –– Nubra – Nubra Valley,  Pangong Lake – Leh ,  Delhi
images: images/india_tours/Srinagar with Leh Ladakh Tour/images nu.jpg

days.title: Delhi - Srinagar
days.desc: On arrival at the Srinagar Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative who will assist and escort you to your waiting vehicle. From the airport it is a 35 minutes’ drive through the heart of New Srinagar city. The drive takes you past the Abdullah bridge which connects the banks of the Jehlum river, snaking its way towards the North-Western frontier of Kashmir. Arrive and check in at hotel/Houseboat. Later some half a day of local sightseeing of Srinagar which include the Mughal Gardens, visiting Nishat Bagh built by Asaf Khan, the brother -in- law of Jehangir in 1632 AD, and Shalimar Bagh built by Jehangir for his wife empress Nur Jahan. Built in between a period of 14 years the two gardens are a heritage left behind by the erstwhile Mughals, whose taste for laying          exquisite gardens was fascinating. All the gardens are situated on the banks of the Dal Lake with the Zabarwan hills in the background. Rest of the will be at your leisure for individual activities. Overnight stay at Srinagar.

days.title: Srinagar - Pahalgalm – Srinagar (60 Km / 2 Hrs)
days.desc: After Breakfast drive to Pahalgam and full day excursion to Pahalgam 2440 Mtrs (vale of Kashmir) on the way visit Saffron fields,  Avantipur ruins and Anantnag sulpher spring. Pahalgam is the most famous place for Indian Film Industry. Enjoy the nature charm of the valley. Golf ground 18 hole golf ground is one of the best in world. With snow-capped mountains around and small pond at the centre of the ground this is one of the scenic golf ground of Kashmir valley. Due to snow this ground remains close in winter season and opens after April month. This well maintained golf ground has all type of facility for beginner to expert players. Zoo ( deer park)There is a small zoo on the way to Aru valley. You can see beer, leopard and deer here. You can walk from your hotel and it is located other side of the river from main market area. It is a favourite picnic place for locals and school kids. There is a temple & Gurdwara at the centre of the town. Sri Gourishankar temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and it is written that Lord Shiva left his bull here before travelling to Amarnath. There is a beautiful Masjid located at the entrance of the town. While entering to town you will get various welcome boards welcoming tourists and Amarnath Yatra devotees. River will be at your left while entering to market and road will be passing by the side of the river. Pahalgam is also famous for Sri Amarnath Yatra, this town became busy during July to September as a base camp before starting the trek from Chandanwari 15 KM from Pahalgam. Pony ride Throughout Pahalgam you will be approached by people offering horse ride to nearby areas. There is no fixed rate for pony ride and you can bargain for a better price. After sightseeing back Hotel in Srinagar, Overnight stay Srinagar.

days.title: Srinagar – Kargil (204 Kms)
days.desc: After breakfast drive directly to Kargil & drive through Sonamarg. Situated at an altitude of 9000 Ft. Sonamarg – 84 Kms is also called as “The meadow of gold” has, as its backdrop, snowy mountains against a cerulean sky. The Sindh River that meanders through the valley abounds with trout and mahaseer. Stop at Sonamarg for Photography/tea (If the clients are interested they can visit the Glaciers of Thajwas on ponies on direct payment basis) these glaciers remain throughout the year. Continue your towards Kargil and passing over Zojila Pass. Stop at Drass, the 2nd coldest inhabitant place in the World for & enjoy cup of tea. Then drive along the Drass River till one arrives at Kargil. And Check in at Hotel.Overnight stay at Hotel in Kargil.

days.title: Kargil - Leh  (Approx. 234 Km)
days.desc: After breakfast proceed for Leh. Enroute pass the confluence of Indus – Zanskar Rivers and the effects of Magnetic Hill (Defiance of the law of gravity). Visit Gurudwara Patthar Sahib and Kali Mata temple.On the NH 1 ( National Highway Number 1 ) connecting Srinagar and Leh you will see Sangam or confluence of Zanskar and Indus river at Nimmu. You can get full view of confluence from NH 1. You can go down up to the river bed by taking a left turn form NH 1 . This road will take you further by the side of Zanskar river. The 14 KM stretch of river in upstream direction ( ending at confluence ) is popular as rafting area.fter crossing Sangam point at a distance of 4 KM further towards Leh you will reach a point known as Magnetic hill.. Here a display board says to stop your vehicles engine at a point and watch how the vehicle moves in upward direction defying the law of gravity. For a better experience turn you vehicles direction towards Srinagar side and stop the vehicle 20 meters before the marking area. You will see your vehicle will start moving on its own in upward direction. It is said that the nearby hills have magnetic effect.By the side of Leh - Srinagar Highway No 1 you can visit this Gurdwara maintained by Indian Army. It is at distance of 24 KM before Leh town while travelling from Kargil - Srinagar side than reach Leh in the evening. Rest for the day. Overnight at Leh

days.title: Leh
days.desc: After breakfast full day visit to Samker Gompa & Leh Bazaar, Leh Monastry, Shanti Stupa and Leh Palace. Tson-Kha-Pa. The Sankar Gompa shares a distance of 2-3 km from the main town of Leh. The monastery remains open from 7 am to 10 am and 5 pm to 7 pm. If you plan to visit the Sankar Gompa then you are going to experience the best of nature’s creation as the surrounding of the monastery shares a marvelous beauty of Himalaya. Else you can also visit the nearby monasteries in Ladakh such as Spituk monastery, Diskit monastery and much more. Shanti Stupa is a Buddhist white-domed stupa (chorten) on a hilltop in Chanspa, Leh district. It was built in 1991 by Japanese Buddhist Bhikshu, Gyomyo Nakamura and part of the Peace Pagoda mission. The Shanti Stupa holds the relics of the Buddha at its base, enshrined by the 14th Dalai Lama.The stupa has become a tourist attraction not only due to its religious significance but also due to its location which provides panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Leh Palace is a former royal palace overlooking the Ladakhi Himalayan town of Leh. Modelled on the Potala Palace in Lhasa, Tibet, the palace was built by King Sengge Namgyal in the 16th century. It is nine storeys high; the upper floors accommodated the royal family, while the lower floors held stables and store rooms. After Leh Palace, visit Leh Temple and Drive back to Leh Bazaar. Overnight in Hotel in Leh.

days.title: Leh – Nubra Valley
days.desc: This morning drive to Nubra valley. On arrival check in camp. In Afternoon visit the popular Samasthanling Monastery at Sumoor followed by dinner and overnight camp. Placed in the Sumlur village of the Nubra valley region, Samstanling Monastery was founded 140 years back in 1841 by Lama Tsultim Nima. The Monastery is 124 km from Leh and serves to more than 50 monks with the daily needs. The place is to be found in the middle of pleasant scenic beauty and is surrounded by traditional hues of Gold, Red Ocher and white. Overnight at Nubra valley

days.title: Nubra Valley
days.desc: Nubra Valley is a wonderful place. Nubra Valley has extremely cold tempertatures during the winter, but the scenario all around is so mesmerizing that it has become a favorite tourist spot in Jammu and Kashmir. The Nubra Valley can be reached from Leh, via many high passes. Lying at a great altitude, a tour to Nubra valley makes for a unique experience. In the morning visit explore Deskit , Hundar and the Sand Dunes where you can enjoy a short camel safari using the double-humped Bactrian camel found here. Diskit Monastery also known as Deskit Gompa or Diskit Gompa is the oldest and largest Buddhist monastery  in the Nubra Valley of Ladakh, northern India. It belongs to the Gelugpa (Yellow Hat) sect of Tibetan Buddhism. It was founded by Changzem Tserab Zangpo, a disciple of Tsong Khapa, founder of Gelugpa, in the 14th century. It is a sub-gompa of the Thikse gomp Beautiful but remote, Hunder village sits like an oasis in the middle of cold desert in Nubra valley of Jammu and Kashmir. Seven km from Diskit which is known for its Buddhist monastery, Nubra has acquired fame for its sand dunes, the cold desert that surrounds it, Bactrian camels and its breath-taking natural beauty. Situated close the Siachen glacier and Pakistan border in Jammu and Kashmir in north India, entry beyond Hunder village is barred as the area ahead is controlled by the Indian Army. Hunder is approximately 160 km from Leh and one has to cross Khardung La, the world’s highest motorable pass to reach the remote village. The high altitude desert, with rolling expanse of sand dunes and barren landscape is the USP of Hunder village. The cold desert and sand dunes seem enigma to scores of tourists who come to visit the spectacle. Later drive back to Nubra. Overnight at Nubra valley.

days.title: Nubra Valley – Pangong Lake
days.desc: After early Breakfast drive to Pangong Lake. On arrival check in to the camp. Afternoon visit to Pangong (14,500 ft) through Changla Pass the third highest motor able mountain pass in the world, Chang La Pass, situated at an altitude of 5,360 meters above sea level, is named after the Sadhu Changla Baba. Enjoy the beauty of the lake on the Banks of pangong while appreciating the changing Colors and fascinating high altitude of the Lake. Overnight stay at camp in Pangong.

days.title: Pangong Lake - Leh
days.desc: After breakfast drive to Leh. On arrival, check in hotel in afternoon. Take rest than evening is at leisure. Overnight stay at hotel in Leh.

days.title: Leh – Delhi By Flight
days.desc: After breakfast drop at Leh airport for onward journey.

days.title: - Leave Delhi
days.desc: After breakfast transferred to the international airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your wonderful journey through India

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit?
faqs.a: October to March is ideal as the weather is pleasant.

faqs.q: Are the monuments open every day?
faqs.a: Most are open daily, but Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays.

faqs.q: Does the tour include guides?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking (or language of choice) guides are provided.
